trans-unit.source: Enables or disables the best sellers page in your shop. When disabled, the page and related links are also removed from the sitemap and other sections.
trans-unit.target: 인기 상품 페이지를 사용하거나 사용하지 않습니다. 사용하지 않으면 사이트맵과 다른 영역에서도 해당 페이지 및 관련 링크가 제거됩니다.
trans-unit.note: Exact static label observed in the isolated native administrator inventory; no stored customer or category data replacement.

trans-unit.note: Exact static label observed in the isolated native administrator inventory; no stored customer or category data replacement.

trans-unit.source: Enables or disables the suppliers listing in your shop. When disabled, suppliers are also removed from the sitemap and other related sections.
